import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import os

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")

# Drop id column from both datasets (it will be added back for submission)
train_features = train_df.drop(["Id"], axis=1)
test_features = test_df.drop(["Id"], axis=1)

# Create hold-out validation set from training data only
X_train_val = train_features.copy()
y_train_val = train_df["Cover_Type"].values

X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_val, y_train_val, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train_val
)

# Train model on training split
clf = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=20,
    min_samples_split=10,
    min_samples_leaf=5,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    class_weight="balanced",
    verbose=0,
)
clf.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Evaluate on hold-out validation set
val_pred = clf.predict(X_val)
validation_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, val_pred)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {validation_accuracy}")

# Predict on test set
test_pred = clf.predict(test_features)

# Prepare submission
submission = sample_submission[["Id"]].copy()
submission["Cover_Type"] = test_pred.astype(int)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved successfully!")
